name: Macr*ss F ~Kegasareshi Utahime~
original_name: マク○スF 穢空歌姫～ケガサレシウタヒメ～
source:
Once, there was a war against giants known as the Zentradi.
Humanity, on the brink of extinction, ventured into the vast cosmos, entrusting their future to new frontiers and setting out on a journey.
After many years, peace and coexistence with the Zentradi were achieved—thanks to the songs of a single songstress.

The "Galactic Fairy" Sheryl Nome, the "Super Dimensional Cinderella" Ranka Lee, and the "S.M.S. Pixie Squad Captain" Klan Klang.
Now, these beautiful songstresses and warriors are defiled at the whims of desire, consumed utterly, forced to sing songs of despair and ecstasy.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ056921.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
曾经，有一场针对被称为Zentradi的巨人的战争。
濒临灭绝的人类冒险进入浩瀚宇宙，将未来托付给新的疆域，踏上征程。
许多年后，由于一位女歌手的歌曲，实现了与Zentradi的和平与共存。

“银河妖精”谢丽尔·诺姆、“超次元灰姑娘”兰卡·李、“S.M.S.精灵小队队长”克兰·巴朗。
现在，这些美丽的女歌手和战士被一时兴起的欲望所玷污，被彻底消耗，被迫唱出绝望和狂喜的歌曲。
